sourceIssue.reason: In the Common Math 1 complex-number setting, principal square roots of negative reals are defined. For a>0,b<0, sqrt(b)=i sqrt(-b) and sqrt(a/b)=i sqrt(a/(-b)), so sqrt(a)/sqrt(b)=-sqrt(a/b) exactly. Other sign pairs fail. The source solution's a>0,b<0 branch is valid and the keyed ㄱ,ㄴ follows by discriminants.
